_comment: Example: copy to lecture_chapters.json and edit. Textbook chapters covered by each lecture, used to choose the notation primer for summaries (stan.notation). Keys under 'lectures' are lecture numbers shared by all sections; 'overrides' takes a full lecture id (e.g. 010-lecture-05) when one section differs. Chapters 1-4 are always included, so list only what a lecture covers.
